model_check: Electro-Voice Sx600 family (unsuffixed catalog label); exact manufacturer documentation covers Sx600PI low-impedance and Sx600PIX transformer variants

frequencyResponse.pointsContext: Exact Sx600 manufacturer datasheet frequency-response SPL table at 1 W/1 m. It states the response/impedance data were measured in an anechoic chamber according to EN 54-24 and defines the reference axis at the center of the grille, perpendicular to its surface. Only the published 40 Hz–20 kHz rows with numeric SPL values are transcribed; blank 20/30 Hz rows are omitted without interpolation. The same sheet separately rates sensitivity at 105 dB 1 W/1 m while its 1 kHz response-table row is 103 dB; retain that source discrepancy, and use the table for shape only (the runtime normalizes the curve separately from sensitivity).

notes: Electro-Voice's exact Sx600 datasheet documents both the Sx600PI low-impedance system and the Sx600PIX transformer-input system. The published response limits are 100 Hz–14 kHz at -3 dB (the separate -10 dB range is 70 Hz–16 kHz); the manufacturer response table is retained as a source-backed point set with its anechoic EN 54-24 context, blank rows omitted, and its 103 dB-at-1-kHz versus 105 dB rated-sensitivity discrepancy explicitly noted in pointsContext. The sheet rates sensitivity 105 dB at 1 W/1 m, gives 600 W continuous power handling (2400 W peak is noted but not stored as a second rating), and describes two 12-inch LF/midbass drivers plus one DH2T compression driver (three transducers). The impedance value is deliberately left N/A because the published 4-ohm/3.5-ohm figures are explicitly for the PI version only; the PIX variant uses transformer taps. The 2010 manual revision is not treated as a launch year. The exact sheet also publishes beamwidth and DI/Q tables; they are recorded as a directivity lead only because those aggregate tables are not a full angular polar dataset supported by the current speaker-record schema. Source: https://products.electrovoice.com/binary/Sx600_High_Output_Two-way_Loudspeaker_Datasheet_51_en_9006674443.pdf
